}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},

}
\tikzset{

}

\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fline] (-1.0,-0.75)--(0,0); \draw[fline] (0,0)--(-1.0,0.75); \draw[pline] (0,0)--(1.4,0); \node[fdv] at (0,0) {};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,-0.75) {$\hat\psi$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.0,0.75) {$\hat{\bar\psi}$}; \node[fdlab,above] at (1.3,0.08) {$\mu$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.4,0) {$\hat A_\mu$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.2,-1.55) {(a) vertex $=-ie\gamma^\mu$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.3cm]
    \node[fdv] at (0,0) {}; \node[fdv] at (2.2,0) {}; \draw[pline] (0,0)--(2.2,0);
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,-0.1) {$\mu$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.2,-0.1) {$\nu$};
    \draw[fdmom] (0.75,0.32)--(1.45,0.32); \node[fdlab,above] at (1.1,0.32) {$q$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.1,-1.55) {(b) propagator $=\dfrac{-ig_{\mu\nu}}{q^2+i\varepsilon}$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=11.3cm]
    \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35); \draw[pline] (-1.7,0)--(-0.35,0);
    \draw[fdmom] (-1.55,0.32)--(-0.85,0.32); \node[fdlab,above] at (-1.2,0.32) {$p$};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.7,0) {$\mu$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (-0.7,-1.55) {(c) incoming photon $=\epsilon_\mu(p)$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=14.9cm]
    \draw[blob] (0,0) circle (0.35); \draw[pline] (0.35,0)--(1.7,0);
    \draw[fdmom] (0.85,0.32)--(1.55,0.32); \node[fdlab,above] at (1.2,0.32) {$p$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.7,0) {$\mu$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.9,-1.55) {(d) outgoing photon $=\epsilon^{*}_\mu(p)$};
